# Gn021 — `OFFSET_SURFACE` of complex BSpline base fails parsing only when wrapped

## Description

A face referencing `#157=OFFSET_SURFACE('',#288,20.0,.F.)` where `#288` is a complex `(B_SPLINE_SURFACE ... )` aggregate fails to render. Replacing `#157` directly with `#288` succeeds — broken indirection through `OFFSET_SURFACE` over a NURBS base.

## Reproducer recipe

Author minimal STEP with `OFFSET_SURFACE` referencing a complex `B_SPLINE_SURFACE` aggregate base; reference from `ADVANCED_FACE`.

## Expected kernel behavior

parse offset-of-spline-surface correctly; iso evaluation must descend through offset/extrusion wrappers (cross-ref `Geom_OffsetSurface` over `Geom_SurfaceOfLinearExtrusion`).
